scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:packages
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.checks: pnpm run check:i18n && pnpm run check:ru-locale && pnpm run check:http-errors && pnpm run check:size && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:layers && pnpm run check:z && pnpm run check:perm
scripts.checks:update: pnpm run checks && node scripts/checks/check-i18n.mjs --update && node scripts/checks/check-ru-locale.mjs --update && node artifacts/api-server/scripts/check-error-bodies.mjs --update && node scripts/checks/check-size.mjs --update && node scripts/checks/check-lint.mjs --update && pnpm --filter @workspace/edge-tracker run check:layers:update && pnpm --filter @workspace/edge-tracker run lint:z -- --update
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run checks && pnpm run build:packages
